description: The CONSTANT RECORD clause (§2023:13.18.15) — a COBOL-2014 introduction (absent from the 2002 texts; present in the 2009 CD and, per §2023:E.2 item 10, in the 2014 standard) — a level-01 STRUCTURED CONSTANT whose content is the record's normal initial content (§2023:13.18.15.4 GR1: as though INITIALIZE … WITH FILLER ALL TO VALUE THEN TO DEFAULT) and which no statement may store into (SR2 → COBOL1548). ACTIVE as of P10 Step 15; the structural SRs (§2023:13.18.15 SR1 WS/LS-only; §2023:13.16.3 SR3/SR6/SR13) are COBOL1549; the introduction gate is the VersionConformancePass parse arm (VisitConstantRecordClause). Its own registry row (not folded into constant-entry-2002) per the registry's one-construct-one-gate granularity: the entry and the clause are separate §s with separate SR families.
vcr: ISO §2023:13.18.15 CONSTANT RECORD; ISO §2023:E.2 item 10 (the 2014 standard already carried the clause: external items could not previously be strongly typed); ABSENT from ISO/IEC FCD 1989:2001 and the 2001-12-04 post-ballot text (0 hits for CONSTANT RECORD), PRESENT in the 2009 CD 1.2 clause 13.18.15 (kb/Work PB3600, PB296)
